_about: What the offline geocoder (scripts/geocoder_build.py) takes from the safety-clipped OSM extract, how it ranks it, and the search words for categories and brands. The build copies this file into the database (meta key 'config_json'), so the app ranks with the same numbers. Bump 'version' whenever anything here changes, and say why in 'changelog'.
changelog: 1 (2026-09-26): first version. Places, named streets, addresses, driver POIs (fuel with CNG/LPG, charging, parking, car wash, car repair, tyres, hospital, police, border control) and named destinations (airports, stations, passes, lakes and reservoirs, sights, hotels, malls ...). Occupied areas: places only, flagged occupied=1.

2 (2026-09-26): review fixes. Streets, addresses, POIs and district parents never take an occupied settlement as their city (occupied places no longer pull legal rows); labels label_ka/label_en (for an occupied place always from name:ka, romanised by the national system, never name or name:en; occupied places without name:ka are left out until the owner decides, places.occupied_without_name_ka); curated aliases (Kazbegi = Stepantsminda); border_control within pois.line_checkpoint_km of the occupied areas is no border crossing (kind line_checkpoint, unnamed ones dropped). Ranking: occupied places x0.9, a road-class prior for streets and addresses, lanes and dead ends x0.9 unless the query names one, a query's street-type word that a name lacks x0.85, a bonus for an initial ('ი. აბაშიძის'), street_named_like_place only for streets named wholly after the place or when the place is a city or town. Categories: exact words, then the same stem, then a word still being typed, never one in not_prefix ('პარკი' is no parking).

3 (2026-09-26): after the first full-Georgia run (known queries 59/64). Exact name first (ranking.exact_first): a place or named feature (water, beach, waterfall, cave, pass, ski area, resort, border crossing) whose name is exactly the whole query ranks above the streets and POIs that only carry that name: a street named after a settlement or feature and nothing else, a route that lists it ('სენაკი — ფოთი — სარფი', 'ტირძნისი-დიცი-ერედვი-ხეითი'), one within near_km of a settlement or feature of that name ('Gudauri Access Road'), any when it is a city or town; and above every row found only by reading a word as a settlement ('თბილისის ზღვა' is the reservoir, not 'ზღვა' in Tbilisi). An occupied place included, except that with a position it holds rows near the user only as a route or a neighbour. A street named after a person or a district ('შოთა რუსთაველის დასახლება' is a suburb of Rustavi), and a POI that only shares a far place's name (hotel 'ალმა'), keep their rank. No position and no settlement in the query: streets, and separately addresses, that do not fit like the best rows of the most important settlement among the best-fitting rows lose other_settlement_penalty ('ჭავჭავაძის 37' is Tbilisi's when Tbilisi has a 37; Batumi's exact 49 beats Tbilisi's 49ა; a current name beats an old_name). Water also from landuse=reservoir and water=lake/reservoir/lagoon without natural=water; resorts (leisure=resort, tourism=resort) are POIs of kind resort.

4 (2026-09-26): POI coverage (the second simulator drive found 'rustavelis teatri' only as a university). New kinds, each with its OSM tags in pois.rules: theatre, cinema, museum, gallery, library, zoo, theme_park (water parks move here from park), viewpoint (museum, gallery, zoo, theme_park and viewpoint leave attraction, which keeps attraction and aquarium), sports_centre (gyms, sports halls, ice rinks, public swimming pools; attrs fitness, pool), school, kindergarten, public_service (Public Service Hall, 'იუსტიციის სახლი'), government (other offices, city halls, courts; attrs townhall, court), post_office, pharmacy, bank (attr atm), atm, restaurant, fast_food, cafe, bar, nightclub, shop (named shops of the listed types, attrs per type), car_parts and car_dealer (driver). supermarket also takes shop=convenience and shop=grocery (attr convenience): the Georgian chains (Ori Nabiji, Nikora, Libre, Spar) are tagged convenience. Unnamed POIs stay out except pharmacy, atm and car_parts, which keep them like the driver kinds (the app shows those as one row per kind, and lists them one by one only for a category). New in the builder, no change to the search: kind_words (a POI whose names lack its kind's word also gets '<its name> <word>' as a search name, so 'ამირანი კინო' finds the cinema Amirani, while a bare 'კინო' is no category, since 'ამირანი' alone would anchor the list to 'ამირან ფანცულაიას ქუჩა'); pois.joined_names ('East Point' is also found as 'eastpoint'); attrs accept a list of alternatives. Theatre, cinema, museum, gallery and library get no category words: their names hold the word and a qualifier that the category anchor reads as a place or a street ('რუსთაველის' is a suburb). New categories and brand search words (banks, pharmacies, chains, fast food, electronics). Gate: known queries for the new kinds and count bands.

name_tags._note: name, name:ka, name:en and name:ru get their own columns; every tag here is also searched. Values holding ';' are split.

places._note: base: importance before population. reach_km: how far a settlement's pull goes when a street or address has no settlement area around it. district kinds take the city they lie in as parent_id and part of its importance.
places._occupied_note: occupied_without_name_ka: what to do with a place inside no_go_hard that has no name:ka (about one in six in the 2026-09 sample; name and name:en there are the de facto authorities' forms). 'hide' leaves it out of the database; 'name_ru' keeps it with label_ka = label_en = name:ru. OWNER DECISION PENDING; 'hide' until then, because it shows nothing the owner has not approved.

streets._note: Named ways with these highway values become streets (a way under construction counts with its construction=* class). Ways with the same name are merged when they lie within cluster_m of each other, then again within merge_m inside the same settlement.

addresses._note: Every object with addr:housenumber and addr:street or addr:place. Copies of one address (a shop and its building) within dedup_m are kept once, preferring the building. An address joins the street of the same name within link_m of it; otherwise its addr:street becomes a street of its own ('virtual'). Importance: base + city_weight * the settlement's + street_weight * the street's (+ building_bonus).

pois._note: The first rule whose 'match' fits wins, so a museum in a castle is a museum and a hotel with a restaurant a hotel. match: a list of alternatives, each a set of tag conditions that must all hold ('*' = any value, '!key' = key absent). named: only objects with a name (or brand) are kept; the kinds without it keep unnamed ones too, which the app folds into one row per kind. attrs: extra facts the app can filter on, each a set of tag conditions or a list of alternatives. prior: the kind's share of importance. near_km: nearness scale in ranking (default ranking.near_scale_km.pois): how far people drive to one. dedup_m: copies of one kind with the same name (or both unnamed) this close are kept once. kind_words: see _kind_words_note. joined_names: see _joined_note.
pois._kind_words_note: People name a POI by its name and its kind ('ამირანი კინო', 'East Point mall', 'Aversi aptiaki'), and the search needs every word in one name. So a named or branded POI whose names do not already hold a word of its rule's kind_words (read as a query would read it: the word itself, its stem, or a longer word it begins, so 'კინოთეატრი' holds 'კინო') gets '<name> <word>' as an extra search name, once for each of its main names that reads differently ('ისთ ფოინთი mall', 'East Point mall'), in the order listed (a later word that an added one already holds is skipped). These names go to alt_names: searched, never shown. A bare kind word then finds every POI of the kind by name ('კინო' lists the cinemas), which is what the kinds without category words rely on. hotel and supermarket have none: their names often start with the word already ('სასტუმრო 444'), and the word on a few thousand more rows would fill the search's candidate window (ranking.candidates) and push out the POI whose own name is the query (the shop 'სუპერი' lost to every 'X supermarket'); their category words cover 'X hotel' near the user.
pois._joined_note: A POI name (name, name:ka, name:en, name:ru) of exactly two Latin words, each of at least two letters, is also searchable joined ('East Point' as 'eastpoint', 'City Mall' as 'citymall'): people type brand names without the space. Stored in alt_names like kind_words.
pois._line_checkpoint_note: A barrier=border_control within line_checkpoint_km of no_go_hard stands at the occupation line, which Georgia does not treat as a border: it is never listed as a border crossing. Named ones stay as kind 'line_checkpoint' (found by name only); unnamed ones are left out. Upper Lars, the nearest real crossing, lies about 18 km from the South Ossetia line.

brands._note: Extra search words for brands, mostly Russian and colloquial forms. OSM already carries brand:en on nearly every branded fuel station (research, 2026-09-26). Keys are matched against brand / brand:en / brand:ka / brand:ru after folding.
brands._v4_note: From config v4: banks, pharmacies, grocery chains, fast food, electronics, the post and a cinema chain, the brands with the most OSM objects in legal Georgia on 2026-09-26. The Georgian form is listed too, because many of these objects carry only brand (Georgian) without brand:en.

categories._note: Words that mean a kind of place rather than a name. A query made of them (with or without a place name, 'parking vake') lists the nearest of that kind. attr narrows to POIs carrying that attrs value. A word matches exactly, or by the same stem ('hotels', 'აეროპორტამდე'), or, as the last word of the query, as the start of a longer category word ('parki' -> parking); not_prefix lists finished words that must never count as such a start.
categories._new_note: From config v4. Words for kinds people ask for as 'the nearest one'. Kept out on purpose: theatre, cinema, museum, gallery and library (see the v4 changelog; kind_words find them by name), and public_service ('სახლი' in 'იუსტიციის სახლი' is a noise word, so the phrase could never match; the name finds it). No bare word here may be the start of a common name word ('ტექნიკა' would read 'ტექნიკური უნივერსიტეტი' as electronics; 'ღვინო' would read 'ღვინის მუზეუმი' as a wine shop), and no phrase may hold a noise word (fold noise_words), which the query drops. government has none either ('მერია' is also a village, and 'გამგეობა' would read the 'გამ' of Gamsakhurdia still being typed). The not_prefix lists keep what a word still being typed read before v4: 'par' parking (not pharmacy), 'ელე' and 'ელექტრო' charging, 'საც' and 'ზაპ' fuel, and keep 'view', 'aqua', 'sport' and 'bak' (Bakuriani) from reading as a category; checked by reading every place, street and POI name of the 2026-09-25 database, whole and as its first word typed letter by letter, under v3 and v4.

ranking._note: How the reference search (scripts/geocoder_search.py) orders results; the app should use the same. score = text*w_text + importance*w_importance + nearness*w_near (w_near only when a position is given; the weights are then divided by their sum). text: per required query word the best of exact / same stem / prefix, averaged, times (1 - coverage_weight + coverage_weight * share of the name's words the query covered), plus optional_bonus per street-type word that also matches (street-type and noise words never count in that share); city_bonus is added to the text of a row in a settlement the query names. nearness = 1 / (1 + km / near_scale_km of the table). Then, after that division: streets and addresses add street_class_prior of their road class; occupied places are multiplied by occupied_factor; without a position or settlement, streets and addresses that do not fit like the centre's best rows lose other_settlement_penalty. Last, exact_first holds streets and POIs that only carry the name of an exact place or feature, and rows of the settlement reading, below it.
ranking._number_note: A query with a house number wants an address: streets, places and POIs whose names lack that number get number_not_in_name, so an address that has the number wins and its street stays the fallback ('number not found').
ranking._street_note: Streets are often named after places ('გუდაურის ქუჩა', 'Batumi Street', 'სენაკი — ფოთი — სარფი'): when a street only carries the name of a place or feature that is the whole query (see exact_first), its text score is multiplied by street_named_like_place, and exact_first then keeps it below that place. A person-named street ('აკაკი წერეთლის გამზირი' for 'tsereteli') keeps its score against a village of that name farther than exact_first.near_km, and against a district named after the same person ('შოთა რუსთაველის დასახლება'). Streets are also named '[given name] [surname] [type]' and people say only the surname, so for streets and addresses the coverage share forgives one uncovered word when the name has two or more words besides the type and the number.
ranking._exact_first_note: Exact name first. An exact row is a place (any kind, occupied ones included) or a POI of feature_kinds, found by the reading that needs every word, with a name whose words (street-type and noise words aside) are exactly the query's required words, one to one, each as typed or its nominative ('ბათუმში' is ბათუმი; 'თბილისის' is not თბილისი, so the genitive 'სარფის' reads as a street name and finds 'სენაკი — ფოთი — სარფი' first). The rule is off when the query has a street-type word outside type_groups ('ბოდორნის გზატკეცილი' asks for the road; 'სოფელი ერედვი' does not). A street or POI only carries an exact row's name, and is held by it, when (a) it is a street found by the reading that needs every word, the exact row is a place of near_kinds or a feature, and the street's matched name (the one that scored best) is the query's words and nothing else (street-type words aside; noise words count, as 'Георгия' folds to the noise word 'georgia'), one to one, each the word itself or a form with its stem ('ერედვის ქუჩა', 'Eredvi Street', 'სარფი' as a road name; never a longer word the query only begins, 'გალფი' for 'გალი'), (b) the exact row is a place of whole_kinds (any street or POI), (c) one of its names, split at dashes (- ‐ ‑ – — ―), has a part whose words are exactly the query ('სენაკი — ფოთი — სარფი', 'ტირძნისი-დიცი-ერედვი-ხეითი'), or (d) it lies within near_km of an exact place of near_kinds or an exact feature (a street by its box, a POI by its point: 'Gudauri Access Road', the ski area of Gudauri). A street whose matched name is an exact place's name and nothing else (as in (a), but for any exact row, a district included) and every street held by (b), (c) or (d) also take street_named_like_place. So a district (suburb, quarter, neighbourhood) named after a person holds no street of that person elsewhere ('შოთა რუსთაველის დასახლება' in Rustavi and Batumi's 'შოთა რუსთაველის ქუჩა'), and a POI that only shares a far place's name keeps its rank (hotel 'ალმა' against the hamlet ალმა, market 'პანდა' against 'პანდას ტბა'). Occupied exact places: with a position, one holds a street or POI inside the local box around the user (candidates.local_box_deg) only by (c) or (d), and holds no settlement-reading row there, so Tbilisi's 'თავისუფლების მოედანი' stays first for 'თავისუფლება' in Tbilisi, while without a position, or for rows far from the user, the occupied place comes first and explains. A held row, and every row found only by the reading that takes a word as a settlement ('თბილისის ზღვა': 'ზღვა' in Tbilisi), scores at most the best score of the exact rows that hold it minus margin; rows so held keep their own order. Anchored rows (an occupied place named beside other words) and category lists are not touched.
ranking._other_settlement_note: No position and no settlement in the query ('ჭავჭავაძის 37', 'chavchavadze'). For streets, and separately for addresses, each matching row has a fit: first its tier, (number, current name), then its text score (after the house number's fit, number_not_in_name and street_named_like_place). Number (addresses only): 2 when the house number is the query's number and nothing else, 1 when it holds it among other numbers ('20-22', '166 კორპ. 8'), 0 when it only begins with it ('49ა') or lacks it. Current name: 1 when the best reading is one of name, name:ka, name:en, name:ru (for an address its street's, or addr:place), 0 when only old_name, alt_name, official_name ... match. The best-fitting rows are those of the best tier whose text is within other_settlement_margin of the best text of that tier; the centre is the most important settlement (city_id) among them, i.e. the lowest places.id (the capital first, then by population and admin rank; see places.capital_bonus and population_weight). A row keeps its score when it belongs to the centre, or lies within its city reach (reach_km x city_reach_factor, at least city_reach_min_km), and matches through a current name whenever the best-fitting rows do; every other row loses other_settlement_penalty. As the centre is chosen among the best-fitting rows, no row that fits better than the centre's best is ever penalised: 'ჭავჭავაძის 37' is Tbilisi's when Tbilisi has a 37, but when only Batumi has an exact 49 (Tbilisi a 49ა, or 9/49) Batumi's 49 comes first; a street matched only through its old_name loses to one that has that name now. Per table, so an address that has the number only in another city still beats the capital's street without it ('number not found'). A position (nearness) or a settlement in the query ('ჭავჭავაძის 37, ქუთაისი') decides instead, and places and POIs are never touched.
ranking.occupied_note: Places with occupied=1 are returned like any other place, flagged, with routable=false and a reason ('occupied', or 'occupation_line' for the 100 m band just outside the drawn line), so the app can explain; the app never routes to them. They are multiplied by occupied_factor, so a legal place of the same name and about the same importance comes first; a clearly more important occupied place (a village of 2500 people against a hamlet) stays first, flagged. A query that names an occupied place beside other words returns that place first.
ranking._class_note: Added to the final score of a street (and of an address, by its street): people who say only a surname mean the avenue, not the lane next to them.
ranking._lane_note: A street or address whose name has a lane word is multiplied by lane_factor unless the query has one too.
ranking._type_note: When the query has a street-type word ('isnis kucha', 'პეკინის II ჩიხი'), a name with none of the query's type words is multiplied by type_word_missing when it has no type word at all, not at all when its type word is of the same group (type_groups: 'rustaveli street' for a გამზირი), and by type_word_conflict when its type words are of another group (ისნის რაიონი, პეკინის გამზირი), so the street the query names comes first. A type word in no group counts as another group.
ranking._initial_note: A letter with a dot before a name ('ი. აბაშიძის 5') adds initial_bonus to the text score of a name with an uncovered word starting with that letter (ირაკლი).
ranking._anchor_note: A category query's other words name its centre: the legal settlement or district with that exact name that scores best; among places with the best text within anchor_same_place_km of it, the most specific kind wins (neighbourhood, quarter, suburb, hamlet, village, town, city), because Tbilisi's suburbs are whole administrative districts whose points lie far from the neighbourhood of that name. Only when no place fits, a street whose text scores at least anchor_street_min_text. A query that names a settlement ('rustaveli batumi') searches the rest in that settlement and within reach_km x city_reach_factor (at least city_reach_min_km) of its point; other rows are left to the reading that needs every word.

aliases._note: Extra search names for places whose everyday name OSM does not carry. Each entry names the place by its name:ka (or name) and, when given, its kinds; the names become alternative names at build time (searched, never shown). Keep this short and reviewed.
